Default test case from textbook:
    Expression = expression.binary(
    expression.unary(Token(TokenType.MINUS, "-", None, 1), expression.literal(123)),
    Token(TokenType.STAR, "*", None, 1), expression.grouping(expression.literal(45.67)))
